candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses an intended future action or ordered sequence of future actions that the agent plans to carry out.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing the intended future action(s).

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one action the agent intends to perform subsequently (e.g., running a benchmark, rebuilding an artifact, checking a resource).
The intended action is stated as a future intention, not merely described as completed.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports or interprets already-completed actions or already-observed results.
The reasoning only restates an external instruction without committing to a future action by the agent.

candidate_predicates.name: WEIGHS_ALTERNATIVE_APPROACHES_WITH_TRADEOFFS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning enumerates two or more candidate approaches for the same objective and evaluates their relative benefits, risks, or costs in order to select one.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text comparing candidate approaches and their trade-offs.

assertion_conditions: At least two distinct candidate approaches to the same objective are identified.
Each candidate is assessed for a benefit, risk, or cost that distinguishes it from the others, leading toward a selection or ranking.
exclusion_conditions: Only a single approach is described without comparison.
Multiple steps of one already-chosen plan are listed without evaluating alternatives.

candidate_predicates.name: ATTRIBUTES_DISCREPANCY_TO_MEASUREMENT_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains an observed numerical mismatch or apparent failure as an artifact of the measurement or reference computation (e.g., its precision, scale, or summation order) rather than as a defect in the evaluated implementation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text attributing the discrepancy to the measurement or reference rather than to the implementation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning acknowledges a specific observed discrepancy or failed comparison.
The reasoning provides a causal explanation identifying a property of the measurement, reference value, or comparison method as the source of the discrepancy.
The reasoning distinguishes that cause from a fault in the evaluated implementation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning attributes the failure to an actual defect in the implementation.
The reasoning merely repeats the discrepancy or expresses confusion without a causal explanation.
The reasoning speculates about an environmental cause without any identifiable supporting property of the measurement.

candidate_predicates.name: IDENTIFIES_PERFORMANCE_BOTTLENECK
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning localizes the dominant share of a measured runtime to a specific stage or component of the execution pipeline, using timing evidence, so that this stage becomes the target of optimization.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text attributing most of the measured runtime to a specific stage or component.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references a measured runtime or timing breakdown.
The reasoning attributes the dominant cost to an identifiable stage or component rather than to the whole system in general.
The identified bottleneck is presented as the reason to redesign or optimize that stage.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only that performance is inadequate without locating a dominant cost.
The reasoning proposes optimizations unrelated to any identified cost contributor.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion using identifiable content of the observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the evidence-based conclusion.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying the supporting evidence.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion or judgment (e.g., accuracy is sufficient, a resource is adequate, a result is stable).
Identifiable content of the observation (values, diffs, metrics, resource figures) provides evidential support for that conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the stated conclusion or provides no identifiable support.

candidate_predicates.name: IMPLEMENTS_DECISION_IN_ARTIFACT
candidate_predicates.definition: An artifact-writing action produces content that embodies a design decision or approach previously specified in reasoning, with traceable correspondence between the described design and the written artifact.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the design or approach to be realized.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action that writes the artifact realizing that design.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies an identifiable design decision, structure, or approach.
The action writes or rewrites an artifact whose content reflects that specified design rather than an unrelated change.
exclusion_conditions: The written artifact does not correspond to the design described in the reasoning.
The reasoning only describes a problem without specifying a design that the action could realize.

candidate_predicates.name: CORRECTS_FLAWED_VERIFICATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies that an earlier verification check or comparison baseline was itself invalid, and a subsequent action re-executes the verification with a corrected reference or method.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying that the earlier verification method or reference was flawed.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action re-running the verification with the corrected reference or method.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explains why the earlier check's reference, tolerance, or comparison procedure produced a misleading result.
The action repeats the verification using a corrected reference or method consistent with that explanation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a defect in the implementation rather than in the verification procedure.
The action simply repeats the identical check without changing the reference or method.

candidate_predicates.name: ASSESSES_OUTCOME_AGAINST_REQUIREMENT
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning compares a measured outcome reported in an observation against a quantitative acceptance requirement stated or referenced in the reasoning, and judges whether the margin is adequate.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning evaluating the measured outcome against the stated requirement.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the measured outcome values.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references a quantitative acceptance requirement or threshold.
The reasoning compares measured values from the observation against that requirement and states whether the requirement is met and how large the margin is.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning reports measured values without comparing them to any requirement.
The observation contains no measured outcome relevant to the requirement.

candidate_predicates.name: RESOLVES_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action gathers information about a specific open assumption or uncertainty raised in reasoning, and the resulting observation provides evidence that settles or informs that assumption.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted information-gathering probe.

parameters.name: assumption_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the assumption or uncertainty to be checked.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the probe outcome relevant to the assumption.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific open assumption or uncertainty whose resolution affects subsequent decisions.
The action is directed at obtaining information about that assumption.
The observation reports information that directly addresses the assumption.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated assumption.
The observation does not address the assumption being checked.
No identifiable assumption or uncertainty motivates the probe.

candidate_predicates.name: SUBSTITUTES_EQUIVALENT_MEANS_AFTER_TOOL_FAILURE
candidate_predicates.definition: After an observation reports that an attempted tool, command, or facility is unavailable or errored, a subsequent action pursues the same informational or functional goal through a different tool or mechanism.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the attempted tool or command was unavailable or failed.

parameters.name: substitute_action
parameters.description: The action achieving the same goal through an alternative tool or mechanism.

assertion_conditions: The observation indicates the attempted operation could not be performed (e.g., tool or command not found, error result).
The substitute action targets the same goal that the failed operation was meant to achieve, using a different tool, command, or data source.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports success, so no substitution is needed.
The substitute action addresses a different goal than the failed operation.
